questions.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=4u+a,\,y=6u+bv+c
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 \\ 6 & 2\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$
questions.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

We can carry out the matrix operations using the matrix form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 \\ 6 & 2\end{aligned}]}}\cdot \overset{u}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}}+\overset{b}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1\end{aligned}]}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4u \\ 6u+2v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4u \\ 6u+2v-1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding elements, we obtain

$$
x=4u+0,\,y=6u+2v+(-1)
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=0+2+(-1)=1.
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=au+v,\,y=bu+cv
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ 9 & 3\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$
questions.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

We can carry out the matrix operations using the matrix form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ 9 & 3\end{aligned}]}}\cdot \overset{u}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}}+\overset{b}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2u+v \\ 9u+3v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2u+v \\ 9u+3v\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding elements, we obtain

$$
x=-2u+v,\,y=9u+3v
$$

questions.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=4u+av-2,\,y=bu+cv-3
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 9 & 5\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -3\end{aligned}]
$$
questions.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

We can carry out the matrix operations using the matrix form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 9 & 5\end{aligned}]}}\cdot \overset{u}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}}+\overset{b}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -3\end{aligned}]}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4u-v \\ 9u+5v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4u-v-2 \\ 9u+5v-3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding elements, we obtain

$$
x=4u+(-1)v-2,\,y=9u+5v-3
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=-1+9+5=13.
$$

questions.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=2u+5v,\,y=u-3v
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 \\ a & b\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ c\end{aligned}]
$$
questions.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

First, notice that we can express the given transformation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2u+5v \\ u-3v\end{aligned}].
$$

Separating the constants and expressing the linear part as a product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2u+5v \\ u-3v\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2u+5v \\ u-3v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 \\ 1 & -3\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=1+(-3)+0=-2.
$$

questions.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=v-7u,\,y=2v-u
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}a & 1 \\ -1 & b\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}c \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$
questions.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

First, notice that we can express the given transformation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}v-7u \\ 2v-u\end{aligned}].
$$

Separating the constants and expressing the linear part as a product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}v-7u \\ 2v-u\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-7u+v \\ -u+2v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}-7 & 1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=-7+2+0=-5.
$$
